name: Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd.
summary: Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells photosensitive materials and polymer products in Japan, China, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers negative photosensitive materials for use as a cross-linking agent for photo-curing resins; positive photosensitive materials for microfabrication of semiconductor integrated circuits and liquid crystal displays; chemically amplified photoacid generator for microfabrication of semiconductor integrated circuits; and acrylic polymer for resist.
